gloss: nominally; in name only; on paper

definitions.gloss: nominally; in name only; on paper
definitions.explanation: Describes something that is true only in name or on official records, while the actual situation is different. Frequently used in business and politics to contrast titles or statuses with real power or function.

examples.japanese: {名目上|めいもくじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧だ。
examples.english: He is president in name only.

examples.japanese: {名目上|めいもくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{責任者|せきにんしゃ}→責任者：17175_sekininsha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}めている→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: He is the person in charge in name only, but in reality someone else makes the decisions.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名目上|めいもくじょう}⟦{独立|どくりつ}→独立：03488_dokuritsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実質的|じっしつてき}→実質的：06171_jisshitsuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{親会社|おやがいしゃ}→親会社：19734_oyagaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{支配|しはい}→支配：01421_shihai⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company is nominally independent, but is effectively controlled by the parent company.

notes:
An adverb indicating that something is true only in name or on paper, while the reality is different. Frequently used in business, politics, and organizational contexts to contrast official titles or statuses with actual power or function.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名目上|めいもくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧: nominal representative
- {名目上|めいもくじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧～だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧: nominally ~ but...
- {名目上|めいもくじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧: ostensible reason

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{形式上|けいしきじょう}→形式上：22071_keishikijou⟧ — formally; emphasizes official form/procedure rather than titles
- ⟦{表向|おもてむ}き→表向き：17918_omotemuki⟧ — outwardly; what is presented to the public
- ⟦{実質的|じっしつてき}→実質的：06171_jisshitsuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ — effectively; in substance (often used as the contrast)
